newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Founder to place 50 mln shrs at HK$3 each.
newsitem.headline: Founder to place 50 mln shrs at HK$3 each.

text.p: Software development and system integration concern Founder (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Friday it would place 50 million new shares, or 9.09 percent of Founder's enlarged share capital, to private investors at HK$3.00 each.
The placing price represents a 4.76 percent discount to the Thursday closing price of HK$3.15 per share, Founder said.
Yamaichi International (H.K.) Ltd is the placing agent.
The stake held by Peking University, the controlling shareholder of Founder, will be diluted to 46.02 percent from 50.625 percent on completion of the placement on January 10.
Founder said half of the net proceeds of about HK$148 million would be used for the development and expansion of new software products, with the other half used for general working capital.

It said the products would include an integrated management information system to be used in the publishing industry, a geographic information system, an integrated management network for use in the broadcasting industry, a public security system for use by police departments and a commercial software interface system.
